$comment: The production origins of the website and the web app (decision D-20), and the earlier addresses that redirect to them. Nothing else spells them: the website's defaults (website/src/config/urls.ts), the pitch deck, the Deploy and Release workflows (the app's APP_URL), the old app address's redirects (tool/web/package_vercel.py) and the Android App Link hosts read this file; website/vercel.json's redirect, the Android manifest and every address in the docs are checked against it (the website's unit tests, tool/android/check_manifest.py, make docs-check C17). 'legacy' addresses redirect permanently to 'origin' from the repository; 'aliases' redirect by the Vercel project's domain setting.
